sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0e499952-46c7-4172-8c70-186312e240a3', '1f306ad2-3606-4525-5a8a-ce78f426c1a2') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
